svg.title: NULL: four bytes of address family
svg.desc: The NULL/loopback pseudo-header of frame 1 of radius_localhost.pcap: the four bytes 02 00 00 00 are the address family AF_INET written in the byte order of the capturing host, read both ways and matched against the version nibble of the IP header that follows; the crate exposes the result as a RawIp link layer with ip_version 4 and the 115-byte IPv4 packet as payload.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
